final_message:
The executed PPA departs from the binding term sheet in 26 flagged ways (plus a table of terms that do match), and on the tax equity checklist financial close is HIGH / RED: April 15, 2025 cannot be met without a signed written amendment. Only two departures were agreed per the negotiation summary — the 75% (637,500 MWh) production guarantee and the 50% shortfall LD rate. The tax equity blocker is that "Financing Party" covers senior lenders only and Exhibit H §8 expressly carves out tax equity, so Ridgeline gets no consent-free assignment or step-in rights; Ridgeline's admission at close would also make Seller's §11.1(g) "wholly owned" representation false at COD (an Event of Default) and may count as a change of control under §17.1(b).
